metadata.description: Unit placements July 3, 1863, approximately 9:30am to 3:20pm. THE CLIMACTIC SEQUENCE: Confederate cannonade ticks 518-542, Pickett's Charge steps off tick 538, Confederate assault crosses open fields ticks 538-553, Armistead over The Angle tick 551, Armistead falls tick 552, Cushing KIA tick 553, Confederate repulse ticks 554-556, East Cavalry Field ticks 560-565, Farnsworth's charge ticks 568-569, both armies exhausted.

placements.notes: THE CANNONADE BEGINS. Washington Artillery firing. 170 Confederate guns simultaneously.
Dearing's battalion firing
Cabell's battalion firing
Pegram's battalion firing -- Herr Ridge guns among the loudest
McIntosh's battalion firing -- Whitworth rifles at extreme range
Cushing's battery returning fire during cannonade
Brown's battery -- severely hit during cannonade. Brown wounded.
Woodruff's battery in action
Arnold's battery
Garnett's brigade in woods during cannonade -- men lying down under Confederate overshoot
Kemper's brigade in woods
Armistead's brigade lying in woods -- cannonade thundering overhead
Webb's brigade pressed flat -- Alexander's first message to Pickett sent this tick
Cushing's battery -- Hunt silencing some Union guns to conserve ammunition
Vermont Brigade watching Confederate line -- Stannard ready
Garnett's brigade stepping out of the tree line -- Alexander's second message sent
Kemper's brigade dressing ranks in the open
Armistead's brigade -- Armistead places hat on sword as guide
Pettigrew's division stepping off Seminary Ridge
Brockenbrough's brigade in line
Fry's brigade stepping off
Davis's brigade in line
Lane's brigade -- Trimble commanding
Lowrance's brigade in line
PICKETT'S CHARGE BEGINS. Garnett's brigade in Line of Battle advancing east
Kemper's brigade -- mile-wide Confederate front stepping off
Armistead's brigade -- Armistead with hat on sword leading
Pettigrew advancing -- Marshall commanding brigade
Brockenbrough's brigade advancing
Fry's brigade advancing
Davis's brigade advancing
Lane's brigade with Trimble
Lowrance's remnants advancing
8th Ohio in advanced position -- watching Brockenbrough's left flank approach
BROCKENBROUGH COLLAPSES under 8th Ohio enfilading fire -- retreating WHILE others advance
Pettigrew's other brigades maintaining alignment
Kemper obliquing left toward Copse of Trees -- right flank exposed
Garnett's brigade -- heavy artillery casualties
Armistead's brigade -- still advancing
Kemper reaching Emmitsburg Road fence -- crossing under heavy fire
Garnett at Emmitsburg Road -- Garnett on horseback conspicuous
Armistead's brigade -- advancing steadily
STANNARD'S FLANKING ATTACK. 13th Vermont wheels left -- pouring fire into Kemper's right flank
14th Vermont wheels left with 13th VT
16th Vermont -- will make SECOND wheel against Wilcox
Kemper's brigade taking devastating flanking fire from Vermont Brigade
Garnett's brigade approaching stone wall -- about to reach The Angle
Pettigrew's brigades at the stone wall north of The Angle
Smyth's brigade firing at Pettigrew at close range
12th NJ firing buck-and-ball at point-blank range into Pettigrew's men
Garnett's brigade at the stone wall. Garnett on horseback -- conspicuous to all.
Webb's brigade firing across the wall at close range
Cushing -- wounded twice, serving last two guns at the wall
Garnett's brigade charging the wall. GARNETT KIA on horseback. CS-005.
Armistead's brigade approaching the wall with Armistead hat on sword
ARMISTEAD LEADS MEN OVER THE WALL. Hat on sword. The High Water Mark.
Webb's brigade at the wall -- Armistead's men pouring over
Cushing rolling last two guns to the wall itself
ARMISTEAD MORTALLY WOUNDED beyond the wall. Falls touching a Union gun. CS-007.
Cushing's battery -- Cushing still alive, serving the gun
CUSHING KIA -- shot through mouth at The Angle. Fuger assumes. US-023.
Cowan's battery firing canister into Armistead's men at 50 yards
Devereux leads 19th MA to plug The Angle without orders
Armistead's men repulsed -- streaming back over the wall
Garnett's brigade (Garnett dead) broken and retreating
Pettigrew's brigades falling back. Marshall killed.
Lane's brigade retreating
16th VT SECOND WHEEL -- now against Wilcox advancing in belated support
Wilcox's brigade caught by 16th Vermont's enfilade -- retreating
Florida brigade retreating
Hampton's brigade advancing at East Cavalry Field
Fitz Lee's brigade -- Stuart's assault force
McIntosh's brigade blocking Stuart's advance
Custer's Michigan Brigade -- about to charge
Pennington's battery -- East Cavalry Field
Hampton's cavalry charge -- 'Come on, you Wolverines!'
CUSTER'S CHARGE. Custer personally leads. Two lines meet at a gallop.
Hampton wounded in melee -- sabre cut. CS-017. Stuart's cavalry repulsed.
Michigan Brigade holding East Cavalry Field. Stuart repulsed.
Farnsworth's brigade -- DOOMED CHARGE over rocky terrain. Farnsworth protests.
Law's Confederate infantry -- the target of Farnsworth's suicidal charge
FARNSWORTH KIA -- shot five times. A general for four days. Charge accomplishes nothing.
Armistead's surviving men streaming back to Seminary Ridge
Garnett's survivors retreating
Kemper's survivors -- Kemper wounded and briefly captured
Webb's brigade holding The Angle -- Confederate repulse complete
Cowan's battery at The Angle
Vermont Brigade -- double flanking maneuver complete
Armistead's survivors reformed on Seminary Ridge -- Armistead dying behind Union lines
Garnett's survivors. Garnett's body somewhere in the field -- never officially identified.
Webb's brigade -- The Angle secured. Meade considers counterattack.
Hampton's cavalry reformed east of town -- Stuart's attack repulsed
Custer's Michigan Brigade holds East Cavalry Field
Greene's brigade on Culp's Hill -- entire line restored and held
Armistead's survivors on Seminary Ridge -- Armistead died July 5
Vermont Brigade on Cemetery Ridge -- battle effectively over
